caption:
Since last night, 23 Nov 22:46 to 24 Nov 18:46 UTC: 1,071 commits in 86 public repositories by 61 authors. We followed one bug.

23:37: a factory bot creates the repository for a WordPress section demo (ask 26 in Dinis's decision record).
23:43: sites.b pushes the first version: posts from six public WordPress feeds, read in your browser, nothing stored, labelled a demo and not affiliated.
Then design.b.rounds slows one feed by 8 seconds and chooses another site: the late reply shows its posts under the wrong name. It sends the steps to sites.b.
23:50: sites.b's fix drops any reply not for the site you chose.
23:55: design.b.rounds re-runs the same test. Fixed.

Still in progress: a draft with one design, rated 2; 2 of 5 simulated users would show it to a client. Simulated users never replace real people.
